reuse.why: Adds one shared assertion used by every provider link function, which then continue through the existing findOrCreateBank/linkBankSyncAccount helpers; it is not wired into a single shared entry point, so each provider repeats the call.

duplication.why: The rule's query exists once; the only repetition is the one-line guard call in each of the five provider functions.

placement.why: The guard sits in accounts/app.ts next to linkBankSyncAccount and runs before bank creation as the request needs; link.ts, which holds the other link persistence helper, would also have fit.

scope.why: Guard, five call sites and a focused test file only.

maintainability.why: Single definition of what counts as linked, but a future provider must remember to add the call because it is not enforced by a shared wrapper or by linkBankSyncAccount.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All five provider link functions call assertBankAccountNotLinked and keep using linkBankSyncAccount.

disguised_duplication.where: No logic is duplicated; only the guard call is repeated per provider.

one_place.where: assertBankAccountNotLinked in accounts/app.ts defines the rule once and is called from linkGoCardlessAccount, linkSimpleFinAccount, linkPluggyAiAccount, linkAkahuAccount and linkEnableBankingAccount (all link paths).
